evidence: Source review only; no verifier image build or configured judge run exists for this candidate. Judge agent and model: task/task.toml:30-35 is the frozen shared block (REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", OpenRouter base URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). All five judge.toml [judge] headers (lines 1-6 plus mcp_servers) are identical to the frozen template up to the first criterion: only the judge = "claude-code" fallback, no model, reasoning effort, temperature or weight. CLIs and browser: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (SHA256 72998ab8...); lines 16-21 pin @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; line 31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; lines 33-38 install Chromium through the Playwright bundled with the pinned @playwright/mcp, so the browser build follows that pin, and judge.toml line 12 points at /usr/local/bin/chromium. Shared tools: restart_mcp.py (03c1426f...) and score.py (13de2b38...) hash-equal the template copies; test.sh and scoring.toml are also identical to the template, and test.sh performs no install or remote fetch at grade time. Fixed clock: the task has no calendar or run-date rule. The seed is empty (environment/assets/seed_data.json: "snippets": []), no instruction, prompt or criterion contains a date, and the only wall-clock use in the reference is an ungraded stored timestamp (solution/app/server.js:71,84,111). The graded time rules are relative durations only (five-second run budget in environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5, about five seconds for library refresh in behaviour.md:11, timers in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:245,263,272,281,344,362), which do not depend on the run date. Observations outside a defect for this row: the base images are floating tags (tests/Dockerfile:1-2 node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) and apt packages are unpinned (line 12); both are template-controlled and the deterministic sheet treats unpinned apt as a NOTE. The roughly one-second timing gaps in functional/judge.toml:245 and 281 are a judge-timing feasibility question for the tool-feasibility rows, not a fixed-clock matter. raw-evidence-index.json covers scripted golden behaviour only and contains nothing that measures this row.
